errors.notEnoughCash: Not enough cash in the bank.
errors.invalidTender: That tender is no longer open.
errors.noBid: You need to submit a bid first.
errors.starPromised: That consultant is already promised in another bid.
errors.minigameAlreadyPlayed: You've already had the meeting for this tender.

game.welcome: {{firm}} is founded! The company number is on its way, the coffee machine is leased and the LinkedIn post has 14 likes.

staff.leftMany: {{count}} employees quit this quarter. The farewell cake was dry.
staff.arrived: {{count}} new consultants showed up with shiny laptops and high hopes.

tender.noBids: Nobody bid on the tender from {{customer}}. Procurement is taking a long lunch.
tender.playerWon: You won the tender at {{customer}}! {{bidders}} firms bid.
tender.playerWonFramework: You were ranked #{{rank}} on the framework agreement at {{customer}}.
tender.playerLost: You lost the tender at {{customer}}. {{firm}} walked away with it.
tender.awarded: {{firm}} won the tender at {{customer}}, beating {{bidders}} others.
tender.frameworkAwarded: {{firm}} tops the framework agreement at {{customer}}. {{bidders}} firms fought for a spot.

contract.terminatedUnhappy: {{customer}} has terminated its contract with {{firm}}. "We're going in a different direction."
contract.ended: The engagement at {{customer}} has ended. Customer satisfaction: {{satisfaction}} out of 100.

shady.poachSuccess: {{name}} has moved from {{from}} to {{to}}. Apparently it happened over an IPA.
shady.poachFailed: The afterwork with people from {{from}} only produced a large bar tab.
shady.rumorVictim: There are rumours about you going around. Nobody knows who started them.
shady.dnLeak: Business daily exposé: "How {{firm}} really works". It's behind a paywall, but everyone has read it.

scandal.spy_bids: {{firm}} caught snooping on competitors' bids. Fine: {{fine}}.
scandal.spy_salaries: {{firm}} has been collecting payslips from {{target}}. Nobody found it charming.
scandal.plant_mole: Mole exposed! {{firm}} had a "trainee" at {{target}} for four months. Fine: {{fine}}.
scandal.afterwork_poach: {{firm}}'s afterwork was a bit too obvious. {{target}} is not impressed.
scandal.silent_outsource: {{customer}} found out that {{firm}}'s team was in a different time zone. Contract terminated. Fine: {{fine}}.
scandal.cv_pad: "Kubernetes expert since 2009"? {{customer}} checked {{firm}}'s CVs. The contract is gone.
scandal.ghost_cv: {{firm}} offered consultants who don't exist. {{customer}} noticed. Fine: {{fine}}.
scandal.bait_and_switch: {{customer}} got juniors instead of the promised seniors from {{firm}}. The relationship is frosty.
scandal.rumor: Turns out the rumours about {{target}} came from {{firm}}. Awkward.
scandal.dn_leak: The leak about {{target}} was traced back to {{firm}}. Fine: {{fine}}.
scandal.linkedin_post: {{firm}}'s LinkedIn post about {{target}} was widely shared for all the wrong reasons.

award.coffee_machine: Best Coffee Machine in the Industry {{year}}: {{firm}}.
award.creative_timesheets: Most Creative Timesheets {{year}}: {{firm}}. The jury was impressed and slightly worried.

trend.ended: The "{{trend}}" trend is over. Everyone pretends they were never into it.

firm.acquired: {{firm}} acquired a small {{discipline}} agency. The business cards have already been reprinted.
firm.bankrupt: {{firm}} has gone bankrupt. The foosball table is for sale online.
firm.playerBankrupt: {{firm}} has gone bankrupt. The receiver has taken over the foosball table.
firm.bankWarning: The bank called. They were polite, but noticeably less warm than before.

announcements.mug_meeting_room: Would {{name}} please collect their mug from meeting room Fjord View.
announcements.friday_beer_alcohol_free: A reminder that today's Friday beer is alcohol-free. Nobody knows why.
announcements.fridge_cleanup: The fridge will be emptied on Friday at 3 pm. This includes last year's yoghurt.
announcements.printer_on_fire: The printer on the third floor is not on fire. It just smells like that.
announcements.wifi_password: New Wi-Fi password: Password123. IT asks that you stop asking.
announcements.standup_standing: A reminder that stand-up means standing up. It's in the name.
announcements.cake_in_kitchen: There's cake in the kitchen. Nobody knows whose birthday it is. Eat anyway.
announcements.timesheet_reminder: Timesheets are due Friday. Yes, including last month's.
announcements.lost_macbook_charger: Has anyone seen a USB-C charger? It's white. They're all white.
announcements.fire_drill: Fire drill at 2 pm. Please don't bring your laptop and keep coding in the stairwell.
announcements.parking_spot: {{name}} has parked in the CEO's spot. Again.
announcements.jira_down: Jira is down. Productivity is up 40 percent.
announcements.someone_microwaved_fish: To whoever microwaved fish: we know who you are.
announcements.meeting_room_hostage: Meeting room Ocean Glimpse is booked by a meeting that never ends. Send coffee.
announcements.sprint_retro_cake: The retro cake was eaten before the retro started. This will be raised at the retro.
announcements.dress_code: Reminder: a hoodie is not client-meeting attire. Unless the client is wearing a hoodie.
announcements.intern_lost: Has anyone seen the intern? He went to get coffee on Tuesday.
announcements.ceo_birthday: It's the CEO's birthday. The card is at reception. Write something nice.
announcements.coffee_beans_out: We're out of coffee beans. The budget for new ones arrives next quarter.
announcements.fagdag_room: The tech day continues in the canteen. Bring your own chair and strong opinions on TypeScript.
announcements.kombucha_on_tap: The kombucha tap has been refilled. Don't ask who ordered it.
announcements.bench_reminder: Reminder: if you're on the bench, update your CV. And maybe once more.
announcements.overtime_pizza: Pizza for everyone working late tonight. So, everyone.
announcements.compliance_tor: Tor from compliance would like a word with everyone. One at a time. Door closed.
announcements.shredder_busy: The shredder is busy until 5 pm. Please don't ask.
announcements.journalists_in_lobby: There's someone from the business press in reception. Say we're at a team-building event.
announcements.morale_survey: The wellbeing survey is out. It's completely anonymous. Completely.
announcements.pingpong_final: The ping-pong final is at 4 pm. The prize is glory and a hot-dog voucher.
announcements.new_office_plants: The office has new plants. They're real. We checked.
announcements.elevator_pitch: The lift is full of consultants practising their elevator pitch. Take the stairs.
announcements.small_office: Reminder: office space is limited. Please don't take video calls in the loo.
announcements.cash_low: Finance asks everyone to consider whether they really need new Post-it notes.

thoughts.overworked: I haven't seen my family since last sprint.
thoughts.bench_bored: I haven't billed an hour in three weeks and have started painting the office.
thoughts.good_flow: Finally a project where things actually happen.
thoughts.embarrassed: I don't tell people where I work at parties anymore.
thoughts.suspicious: Why is an "external resource" in Manila suddenly answering my emails?
thoughts.star_restless: {{name}} has updated their LinkedIn profile three times this week.
thoughts.underpaid: I think I'm underpaid. No, I know I am.
thoughts.good_pay: The pay is actually pretty decent here.
thoughts.no_learning: I haven't learned anything new since jQuery.
thoughts.fagdag_good: The tech day was actually good. I understood almost all of it.
thoughts.lonely: It's quiet in the office. Very quiet.
thoughts.great_colleagues: I like my colleagues. Is that allowed?
thoughts.who_are_freelancers: Who are all these people without access cards?
thoughts.startup_vibes: It feels a bit like a startup. In a good way, mostly.

ebike_scheme.title: Bike scheme
ebike_scheme.body: A group of employees has made a 34-slide deck on why you need an e-bike scheme.

friday_1655.title: Friday, 4:55 pm
friday_1655.body: {{customer}} is on the phone. Prod is down. Everyone is heading home.

genai_pivot.title: The board wants AI
genai_pivot.body: The board read an article and wants you to "do something with AI". What exactly is unclear.

choices.refuse: We'll keep doing what we're good at.

kickoff.title: Annual kick-off
kickoff.body: It's kick-off season. The social committee has strong opinions.

choices.lillestrom: A conference hotel off the motorway (NOK 3,000 per head)

competitor_cake.title: Cake war
competitor_cake.body: {{firm}} sent a cake with their logo to one of your clients. It was apparently delicious.

leaked_salary_sheet.title: Salary leak
leaked_salary_sheet.body: The salary spreadsheet ended up in the wrong Teams channel. 47 people saw it. Three took screenshots.

kofa_complaint.title: Procurement complaint
kofa_complaint.body: {{firm}} has filed a complaint about your contract award. They say you were "unrealistically cheap".

hackathon.title: Hackathon?
hackathon.body: Someone suggests an internal hackathon. There'll be pizza and at least one idea that goes nowhere.

conference_talk.title: Conference
conference_talk.body: One of your stars has been invited to speak at a tech conference.

burnout_wave.title: Burnout
burnout_wave.body: People are working too much. Some have started sleeping under their desks, and not because it's comfy.

choices.relief: Bring in help and give time off (NOK 300,000)

star_wants_remote.title: Remote work
star_wants_remote.body: {{name}} wants to work from a cabin in Lofoten. Full-time.

choices.grant: Fine, but we want northern lights on Teams.

acquisition_offer.title: Acquisition
acquisition_offer.body: A small agency with 8 good people is for sale. The owner just wants to go sailing.

influencer_post_viral.title: Viral!
influencer_post_viral.body: One of you wrote a post called "What kindergarten taught me about agile". It went viral.

office_ping_pong.title: Ping-pong table
office_ping_pong.body: Someone left a note in the suggestion box: "Ping-pong table?" It's the third one.

javazone_booth.title: Conference booth
javazone_booth.body: Booth registration for the big developer conference is open. Everyone else is getting one.

choices.booth: Big booth with a coffee bar (NOK 250,000)

tax_audit.title: Tax audit
tax_audit.body: The tax authority would like a chat about a few entries in your accounts. They're very polite.

glassdoor_review.title: Glassdoor
glassdoor_review.body: A former employee gave you one star on Glassdoor. The review is long and very accurate.

client_wants_chatbot.title: Chatbot
client_wants_chatbot.body: {{customer}} wants a chatbot. They don't know what it should do, but it has to ship before summer.

choices.no: Shall we start with the problem?

pizza_budget_cut.title: Pizza budget
pizza_budget_cut.body: Finance suggests cutting the pizza budget. It's a number nobody was supposed to know.

christmas_party.title: Christmas party
christmas_party.body: It's time for the Christmas party. Expectations are high after last year.

intern_program.title: Summer interns
intern_program.body: The university asks if you'd like summer interns. They're eager and know a little about everything.

open_source_fame.title: Open source
open_source_fame.body: A small library you built has reached 10,000 stars on GitHub.

cloud_credit_windfall.title: Cloud credits
cloud_credit_windfall.body: A cloud vendor gave you a pile of credits. Someone apparently needed to hit their target.

unionization.title: Union
unionization.body: Employees want to unionise. They've made a Miro board.

fagdag_vs_billable.title: Tech day or invoice?
fagdag_vs_billable.body: The tech day clashes with a client who wants people on Friday. What do you prioritise?

ceo_podcast.title: Podcast
ceo_podcast.body: The CEO has been invited onto a leadership podcast. It'll be 90 minutes.

rebranding_agency.title: Rebrand
rebranding_agency.body: An agency wants to give you a new visual identity. It involves a new font and a lot of orange.

wrong_reply_all.title: Reply all
wrong_reply_all.body: Someone hit reply-all on an email to the client. With a comment that wasn't meant for the client.

coffee_machine_broke.title: Coffee crisis
coffee_machine_broke.body: The coffee machine is broken. Productivity has dropped, and morale even more.

headhunter_calls.title: Headhunter
headhunter_calls.body: A headhunter has called {{name}} three times this week.

remote_debate.title: Office debate
remote_debate.body: There's a full-blown debate about remote work in #general. The thread has 312 replies.

security_incident.title: Security hole
security_incident.body: Someone pushed an API key to a public repo. It's been there for four months.

poach_attempt.title: Afterwork alert
poach_attempt.body: {{firm}} took {{name}} out for drinks. It got late, and salaries were mentioned.

choices.match: Match the offer (+10% salary and half a quarter's pay)
choices.podcast: Cry about it on a CEO podcast
